questions.prompt: Which description best matches the report?
options: Companies were refilling reservoirs after restrictions had been lifted.
Companies were protecting supplies while longer-term drought pressure continued.
Companies were waiting for rainfall before starting their daily checks.
Companies were responding after public water supplies had been interrupted.
questions.explanationZh: 供水仍持续，水务公司采取保护措施，而摆脱旱情需要持续降雨；其余选项把未发生或未完成的事说成已完成。

questions.prompt: Which measure was described as still under consideration?
questions.explanationZh: s10说非必要商业用水限制仍在审议；其他列出的工作在进行或准备中。

questions.prompt: Why did the severe-drought declaration matter while public supplies were still continuing?
options: It allowed extra measures to protect supplies in advance.
It confirmed that recent rain had restored reservoir levels.
It moved responsibility for public supplies to local communities.
It announced the approval of the pending business-use bans.
questions.explanationZh: 宣布旱情使预防性保护措施得以采取；供水责任并未转给居民，也不意味着申请自动批准。

questions.prompt: What did the agency estimate was needed for the country to be considered out of drought by early spring?
options: Rainfall at the usual average level during the next six months.
Rainfall at 120 percent of the average during the next month.
Rainfall at least 120 percent of the average during the next six months.
Rainfall above the average level during the first half of October.
questions.explanationZh: s14同时限定未来六个月和平均水平的至少120%；其他选项改变了时间或数量门槛。
